spec.title: Specific yield
spec.description: Monthly PV yield normalized to installed kWp. Uses investment asset watt_peak values when available and falls back to installedWattPeak.

spec.expr:
WITH (
  gridImport = running_sum(sum(last_over_time(evcc_grid_import_daily_wh{local_year="${__from:date:YYYY}",local_month="${__from:date:MM}"}[1d]))),
  homeEnergy = running_sum(sum(last_over_time(evcc_home_energy_daily_wh{local_year="${__from:date:YYYY}",local_month="${__from:date:MM}"}[1d]))),
  loadpointEnergy = running_sum(sum(last_over_time(evcc_loadpoint_energy_daily_wh{local_year="${__from:date:YYYY}",local_month="${__from:date:MM}"}[1d])) or vector(0))
)
clamp_max(clamp_min(1 - gridImport / clamp_min(homeEnergy + loadpointEnergy, 0.001), 0), 1)

WITH (
  pvEnergy = running_sum(sum(last_over_time(evcc_pv_energy_daily_wh{local_year="${__from:date:YYYY}",local_month="${__from:date:MM}"}[1d]))),
  gridExport = running_sum(sum(last_over_time(evcc_grid_export_daily_wh{local_year="${__from:date:YYYY}",local_month="${__from:date:MM}"}[1d])))
)
clamp_max(clamp_min((pvEnergy - gridExport) / clamp_min(pvEnergy, 0.001), 0), 1)

WITH (
  greenShare = sum(last_over_time(evcc_green_share_home_daily_ratio{local_year="${__from:date:YYYY}",local_month="${__from:date:MM}"}[1d])),
  sumGreenShare = running_sum(greenShare),
  countGreenShare = running_sum((greenShare * 0) + 1)
)
sumGreenShare / clamp_min(countGreenShare, 1)

WITH ( homeEnergy = sum(last_over_time(evcc_home_energy_daily_wh{local_year="${__from:date:YYYY}",local_month="${__from:date:MM}"}[1d])), loadpointEnergy = sum(last_over_time(evcc_loadpoint_energy_daily_wh{local_year="${__from:date:YYYY}",local_month="${__from:date:MM}"}[1d])) or (homeEnergy * 0), gridImport = sum(last_over_time(evcc_grid_import_daily_wh{local_year="${__from:date:YYYY}",local_month="${__from:date:MM}"}[1d])) or (homeEnergy * 0) ) 1 - gridImport / clamp_min(homeEnergy + loadpointEnergy, 0.001)

WITH ( pvEnergy = sum(last_over_time(evcc_pv_energy_daily_wh{local_year="${__from:date:YYYY}",local_month="${__from:date:MM}"}[1d])), gridExport = sum(last_over_time(evcc_grid_export_daily_wh{local_year="${__from:date:YYYY}",local_month="${__from:date:MM}"}[1d])) or (pvEnergy * 0) ) (pvEnergy - gridExport) / clamp_min(pvEnergy, 0.001)

WITH (
  batteryNet = ((last_over_time(evcc_battery_charge_daily_wh{local_year="${__from:date:YYYY}",local_month="${__from:date:MM}"}[1d])) - (last_over_time(evcc_battery_discharge_daily_wh{local_year="${__from:date:YYYY}",local_month="${__from:date:MM}"}[1d]))) / 1000,
  batteryCharge = sum by (series) (label_set((batteryNet > 0), "series", "Battery charge")),
  batteryDischarge = sum by (series) (label_set((batteryNet < 0), "series", "Battery discharge")),
  home = sum by (series) (label_set((last_over_time(evcc_home_energy_daily_wh{local_year="${__from:date:YYYY}",local_month="${__from:date:MM}"}[1d])) / 1000, "series", "Home")),
  loadpoints = sum by (series) (label_copy((last_over_time(evcc_loadpoint_energy_daily_wh{loadpoint!~"$loadpointBlocklist",local_year="${__from:date:YYYY}",local_month="${__from:date:MM}"}[1d])) / 1000, "loadpoint", "series"))
)
home or sort_by_label(loadpoints, "series") or batteryCharge or batteryDischarge
